notes.title: My new hunting horror game announced.
notes.notes:
This is an announcement of my new hunting horror game for PC.

[b][url=store.steampowered.com/app/993110/Skinwalker_Hunt/]Skinwalker Hunt[/url] [/b]is a horror themed hunting game from the creator of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661790/Witch_Hunt/]Witch Hunt[/url][/b]. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linearity, and atmosphere.

You play as a native american monster hunter, who will try to hunt down legendary creature called skinwalker in different parts of the world. You'll be able to find and use different tools and abilities to hunt and survive.

[i]Warning: This is not a story driven game. Successful hunting requires patience and perseverance.[/i]

notes.title: v0.83 (Eng, Рус, 中文) New Darkness sense logic, major balance changes, level design improvements and more.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/5ccbbc35d5a92307e016477d6e2cf70122986b83.jpg[/img]

Version 0.83 is now live. This is probably the most controversial update to Witch Hunt, cause it drastically changes core hunting mechanic of the game and introduces major balance changes, so there's bound to be people who will not like it. For that reason I've made previous version of the game available to public through a seperate steam branch.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Darkness sense skill significantly changed. It no longer consumes mana but works differently.
- Major balance changes.
- Added heavy foggy valley to the forest level.
- New tutorial.
- Level design improvements on forest level.
- Level design improvements on Bellville level.
- Made some improvements to path preferences of bosses.
- Second chance skill will now teleport you to random position.
- Bell sound will now attract enemies if they are nearby.
- Changed Bellville music on day 3.
- If you encounter whisperer it will now attempt to consume 100 mana. Only if you don't have 100 mana, you'll receive additional damage depending on how much mana you've had.
- Fast travel skill now requires full health and consumes 100 mana.
- Spiders no longer spawn mana.
- Tips, texts, video and everything related to old Darkness sense mechanic changed or removed.
- Lightning sound radius increased.
- New icon for silver crucifix ready status.
- Fixed a bug that prevented poisonous plant death sound to be heard.
- Fixed a bug that spawned two watcher totems after game loading.
- Fixed two bugs related to lockpick master skill.
- Small improvements to design of trader shop.
- More healing plants added to Bellville.
- Other small changes and improvements.

 If you want get old version with old Darkness Sense:
 
 1. In your Steam client, go to the Library and right (mouse button) click on Witch Hunt
 2. Select Properties (from context menu)
 3. Select the Betas tab
 4. Select Version_082 from the list on click ok

[h1]Русский:[/h1]
Это, наверное, самое спорное обновление для Witch Hunt, так как оно кардинально меняет основную механику охоты. Поэтому я уверен, что будут люди, которым это не понравится. По этой причине я сделал прошлую версию игры доступной для скачивания через отдельную Steam ветку.
 
 Если вы хотите скачать версию со старой механикой "Чувство тьмы":
 
 1. В своей библиотеке кликните правой кнопкой мышки на Witch Hunt.
 2. В контекстном меню кликните properties (свойства)
 3. Кликните на закладку Betas (Бета-Версии)
 4. Выберите ветку Version_082 из выпадающего списка.

[h1]中文[/h1]
这可能是女巫猎人最具争议的更新，因为它大大改变了游戏的核心狩猎机制，所以肯定会有人不喜欢它。 出于这个原因，我在steam游戏属性中的测试栏单独发布了以前的版本。 
如果您还想使用老版本的黑暗感官，那么请:

1.打开您的steam客户端，进入游戏库，并用鼠标右击Witch Hunt
2.选择属性（从菜单中）
3.选择测试选项
4.在列表中点击选择  Version_082即可

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Witch Hunt
notes.notes:
Premature Evaluation is the weekly column in which we explore the wilds of early access. This week, Fraser’s off to the 18th century to hunt a forest full of nasty monsters in horror FPS Witch Hunt. He’s a very brave boy.

Find a bunch of trees and you ll probably discover a folktale or ghost story set under their boughs. Years ago, I lived right on the boundary of some woodland that was meant to be home to a red-eyed creature that ate children. Walking back from school in winter, when it was already dark, was a nasty business. I d grimly keep my gaze fixed forwards, always trying to avoid glancing to my left. To the trees, and the red eyes that might be hiding between them.

Witch Hunt has more than one monster living within its gloomy, dead forest. It s full of them. For a slayer of supernatural beasties, it should be the perfect hunting ground. Not for me, however, a man with no sense of direction and an acute fear of spooky trees. I am very sweaty and very lost.

(more…)

notes.title: If you still experiencing invulnerable tree bug.
notes.notes:
It's a bit different bug, than the one I've fixed before. Current health bar will reflect sacrificial tree health from 0-6000. Since tree health was more than 6000 before update and your safe file holds old health number for sacrificial tree, it will not start to update health bar until you lower it's health below 6000. So you can just shoot it and eventually that health bar will start to move or you can send me letter to guaindie [at] gmail.com and I'll edit your save file and give it 6000 health.

--------

На самом деле дерево получает урон, но при последнем обновлении игры макс. количество здоровья дерева было изменено. Индикатор здоровья отображает здоровье от 0 до 6000, но из-за того, что ты начал играть на более старой версии, здоровья у дерева было больше чем 6000, если продолжишь наносить ему урон, то рано или поздно индикатор здоровья начнет отображать урон. Ты так же можешь написать мне на guaindie [собака] gmail.com и я исправлю твой сейв.
